title: A Chest Full of Spice
description: Spice might be one of the most important substances in the galaxy. Rare and difficult to obtain, its value on the black market is sky high. The Pykes remark to Cobb Vanth that this one chest is worth more than the entire town of Mos Pelgo. The illicit strains of spice the Pyke Syndicate cultivates are from the mines of Kessel. Being a criminal syndicate, they aren't above using forced labor from captured Wookiees in their operation. The difficulty in getting in and out of Kessel adds to the value of the rare substance.
